description: This file defines the command and request handler for deleting a comment within the Comments feature of the application. It includes validation for the command and performs database operations to locate and remove a comment based on a slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the logic for deleting a comment, including retrieving the article, validating existence of the comment, and performing the deletion.

methods.name: CommandValidator()
methods.description: Constructor that sets validation rules for the command.

methods.name: Handle(Command, CancellationToken)
methods.description: Executes the deletion of a comment based on the provided slug and comment ID.
